text.en:
Today you say what has already happened.
And it still matters now.
I have lost my keys.
So I cannot get in.
She has found her card.
We have finished lunch.

title.en: Have or has, then the done word

text.en:
I, you, we and they: have.
She, he or one thing: has.
Then a word like lost, found or finished.
He has already paid.
We have not ordered yet.
Just means a moment ago.

You will say what has happened.
And ask about it.
Have you ever worked nights?
To say never, use never.
I have never driven a van.
Say yesterday? Then no have.
